EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN SEA.
LIBYA.
1. SEISMIC SURVEY IN PROGRESS UNTIL 30 APR
   BY M/V RAMFORM VANGUARD TOWING 12
   6600 METER LONG CABLES IN AREA BETWEEN
   33-00N 33-45N AND 012-55E 013-45E.
   FIVE MILE BERTH REQUESTED.
2. CANCEL THIS MSG 01 MAY.
